items.question: Under what condition are beings tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams form a specified set of locations.
Beings come to be situated within those womb-diagrams.
Such beings are found in a tormented state within them.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The precise nature of the torment is not specified here.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams hold tormented beings.
